verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operation, such as acting on many sandboxes in one call or command. The SDKs, CLI and API manage individual sandboxes, which makes them developer building blocks a user could script loops with, not a bulk capability. Shared volumes and warm pools are adjacent features, not bulk operations across items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
